adds.rationale: Microsoft signed a 20-year PPA with Constellation on Sep 20 2024 to restart Three Mile Island Unit 1 (Crane Clean Energy Center), dedicating 835MW to its AI data centers — the most concrete, capital-committed buildup signal of the quarter for the profile's nuclear wave, sitting directly at the AI/nuclear intersection this cap had no exposure to.

news_evidence.summary: Constellation announces 20-year PPA with Microsoft; Crane Clean Energy Center to restart TMI Unit 1, 835MW carbon-free power dedicated to Microsoft AI data centers
CEG shares surge ~22% on the Sep 20 announcement; the deal reprices the AI-nuclear thesis sector-wide

removes.rationale: At a binding cap of 3, LMT is the weakest incumbent to fund the fresh nuclear entry: no incremental Q3 catalyst (F-35 TR-3, backlog steady-state), a premium valuation, and the stock cooled ~16% over three months — a mature wave with no fresh catalyst versus one entering buildup.

news_evidence.summary: Lockheed Martin shares down ~16% over the trailing three months on valuation reassessment even as backlog stayed solid ($165.69B) — a cooling after a geopolitical-driven rally, not a fresh catalyst

rationale_overall: Swap the sole defense holding (LMT) for the sole nuclear holding (CEG), keeping the watchlist at cap=3 (MSFT, NVDA, CEG). This trades a mature, already-priced defense wave with no fresh Q3 catalyst for the clearest dated buildup signal of the quarter in the profile's next-wave nuclear thesis — Microsoft's own 20-year PPA to restart Three Mile Island for AI data centers — which also reinforces the AI wave held via MSFT and NVDA. CEG was chosen over NuScale (pre-revenue), VST, and OKLO (more speculative) as the direct PPA counterparty and most liquid name. No change to the AI side; no Q3 news breached that thesis.
